# Materials Research Group

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Science, Technology and Innovation System](https://www.eafit.edu.co/ciencia-tecnologia-innovacion)
- [Investigation](https://www.eafit.edu.co/ciencia-tecnologia-innovacion/investigacion)
- [Our Seedbeds](https://www.eafit.edu.co/sistema-ciencia-tecnologia-innovacion/investigacion/nuestros-semilleros)
- Materials Research

###### General objective

To offer the academic community training scenarios in research methodology that promote and facilitate the early development of scientific skills, aimed at proposing initiatives focused on the creation of new materials or the identification of new applications for existing ones to transform the environment and contribute to a better world.

###### Specific objectives

To have a space for study and analysis around questions about the constitution of materials, their characteristics and properties, so that the capabilities of materials can be identified and their behavior integrated into the world of technology and current daily life can be understood.

To encourage the exchange of knowledge and research results related to materials science for advanced technological applications.

To promote academic interaction between students from different semesters of the undergraduate program in Physics Engineering, as well as integration with students from other undergraduate and graduate programs, in relation to topics associated with materials science and its applications.

To promote the visibility and dissemination of research results at the national and international levels, arising from research actions and projects on materials science, its applications, and its contribution to technological development carried out by the members of the research group.

###### Lines of research

Plasma materials processing line (advanced materials area).

###### Main activities

The research group conducts research and research training activities led by its members and coordinated by the group's lead professor. Each year, the students identify topics in materials science and its applications in advanced technology that they wish to study, explore, and delve deeper into. Based on this identification, they decide whether to develop a research project and prepare the corresponding proposal to be submitted to the Eafit University's small project funding call. If the proposal is accepted, the project is carried out during the corresponding period.
